_doc: Canonical MCP server definitions. Source of truth rendered into opencode.jsonc, ~/.claude.json, .claude/mcp.json, and ~/.codex/config.toml by sync_mcp.py. Edit this file, then run: python3 sync_mcp.py --dry-run
_secret_syntax: Use {env:VAR_NAME} for any secret/OS-specific value. Renderer: opencode keeps {env:VAR}; ~/.claude.json resolves to plaintext; .claude/mcp.json converts to ${VAR_NAME}; ~/.codex/config.toml maps to env_name refs (env_vars/bearer_token_env_var/env_http_headers).
_enabled_semantics: enabled=true -> active. enabled=false -> opencode emits 'enabled:false', claude/mcp.json emit 'disabled:true', codex emits 'enabled = false'. Servers in exclude_from_<target> (e.g. exclude_from_opencode, exclude_from_cursor, exclude_from_qoder) are omitted from that target's config entirely but still written to the others.

deveco-mcp.comment: DevEco CLI MCP: ArkTS / C/C++ static syntax analysis (devecocli serve mcp, tools: check, restart). Requires DEVECO_CLI_CLT_PATH stub — devecocli hard-gates on toolchain presence even for non-build commands; real DevEco Studio toolchain is Windows-only. (Backfilled into canonical 2026-09-04: was opencode.jsonc-only and sync would have dropped it.)

Chrome-DevTools-MCP.comment:
Connects to Brave on Windows via the debug port. Brave must be running with:
brave.exe --remote-debugging-port=9222 --user-data-dir="C:\Users\shana\brave-debug"
WSL is in Mirrored mode (.wslconfig: networkingMode=Mirrored + hostAddressLoopback=true),
so 127.0.0.1 in WSL reaches Windows directly — no 0.0.0.0 binding needed.

Figma-Desktop.comment: Desktop Dev Mode MCP server (RE-ENABLED 2026-09-07 after the 2026-09-04 tools/list hang was resolved). Requires the Figma desktop app running with Dev Mode MCP server enabled (port 3845). In WSL, 127.0.0.1 reaches Windows via mirrored networking. This is the fallback for clients NOT in Figma's MCP Catalog (opencode, Cursor, Qoder).

figma.comment: Figma hosted remote MCP (Figma-recommended). OAuth-only — no static token/headers. Only Claude Code and Codex can authenticate (Figma's MCP Catalog). Excluded from opencode/cursor/qoder via exclude_from_<target>; those use Figma-Desktop instead.

command_opencode: PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.local/share/fnm/aliases/default/bin:$HOME/.volta/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH; export Z_AI_MODE=ZHIPU; export Z_AI_API_KEY=$(cat $HOME/.shanaae/configs/.secrets.d/bigmodel_api_key); exec npx -y @z_ai/mcp-server "$@"

PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.local/share/fnm/aliases/default/bin:$HOME/.volta/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH; b=$HOME/.local/share/pnpm/bin/agentmemory-mcp; [ -x "$b" ] || b=$HOME/Library/pnpm/bin/agentmemory-mcp; export AGENTMEMORY_URL=$(cat $HOME/.shanaae/configs/.secrets.d/agentmemory_url); export AGENTMEMORY_SECRET=$(cat $HOME/.shanaae/configs/.secrets.d/agentmemory_secret); exec "$b" "$@"
